notes: Portable, source-backed resource completion patch. Do not apply this file by replacing the cumulative catalog; merge additions and null-only fills, then run the normal validator and import builder. Optional mine, market, and pile fields remain null because no one common value across HOMM1-HOMM5 was established.

sources.notes: The user supplied this local original manual. Its PDF text and rendered pages name the seven shared classic resources and show the seven mine/resource types. The PDF bytes are not committed to the repository.

sources.title: HOMM1-HOMM2 official-manual-backed catalog and trusted classic taxonomy
sources.notes: The H1/H2 source note records official-manual-backed building costs and resource amounts, while the existing trusted HOMM3 GameResource taxonomy supplies the normalized class mapping used here: Gold=Currency, Wood/Ore=Common, and Mercury/Sulfur/Crystal/Gems=Rare. Existing H1/H2 GameResource memberships are already complete at seven per game, so this patch adds no duplicate junction rows.
